claims.statement_id: Vision Serpent dianggap ular terpenting di antara ular-ular Maya.
claims.quote: The Vision Serpent is thought to be the most important of the Maya serpents.

issues.message: Di bawah target core: 2 klaim (target 6), 1 sumber (target 2). gaps sudah diisi; nilai apakah pencariannya memadai.

claims.statement: The Ahkiyyini is a skeleton spirit of Inuit folklore, the ghost of Alaska, who causes tidal waves and earthquakes by moving his arms.
claims.statement_id: Ahkiyyini adalah roh kerangka dalam cerita rakyat Inuit, hantu Alaska yang menimbulkan gelombang pasang dan gempa dengan menggerakkan lengannya.
claims.quote: The Ahkiyyini is a skeleton spirit in Inuit folklore. He is the ghost of Alaska, and causes tidal waves and earthquakes by moving his arms.

claims.statement: In death he used his arm bone as a drumstick and his scapula as a drum.
claims.statement_id: Setelah mati, ia memakai tulang lengannya sebagai pemukul dan tulang belikatnya sebagai gendang.
claims.quote: In death he would use his arm bone as a drum stick and his scapula as a drum.
